title: Generic detection of maps into a locally constant module sheaf
statement: Let X be an irreducible scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with generic point eta [def-sc-generic-point], and Lambda a commutative ring. Let phi:F to G be a morphism of Lambda-module sheaves on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and suppose G is locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant]. If for every separably closed field Omega and every map s:Spec Omega to X with image eta the geometric stalk map phi_s is zero [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], then phi is zero. Neither F nor G need have finitely generated stalks and neither X nor Lambda need be Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 09BG, Lemma 59.73.12 (3), lemma-irreducible-subsheaf-constant-zero, with the etale-local persistence argument used in Tag 09BH (3)

proof.text: Assume the morphism is nonzero. By exactness and conservativity of geometric stalks its image has a nonzero geometric germ, represented by a section of F whose image in G has nonzero germ.

Pull back to an etale trivialization of G and refine the pointed neighbourhood until the image of this section is a fixed nonzero constant section. This uses the stalk as a filtered colimit and the constant-sheaf stalk formula; refinements preserve the selected nonzero germ.

The neighbourhood has nonempty open image in X; irreducibility forces that image to contain eta. Choose a geometric point of its nonempty etale fibre over eta, passing to a separably closed field if needed. The same constant section remains nonzero at this geometric generic point, contradicting the assumed zero map on every such stalk.

All image stalks must therefore vanish. Exactness and conservativity make the image zero and hence the morphism zero. The zero source or target is included and the empty scheme cannot furnish eta. No finiteness hypotheses are used.

theorem eq_zero_of_generic_sheafFiber_eq_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (η : X) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    [IsLocallyConstantSheaf G] (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
      s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = η → (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.map φ = 0) :
    φ = 0
